name: Makina Yukari
source:
"I will definitely wipe out chikan from this city."

The new mayor of Ikagawa City. She was elected with overwhelming support from women, campaigning on a platform of reducing sexual crimes and eradicating chikan.

Her hobbies are shogi and go. She keeps a hamster as a pet.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/sirius/emtneo/chara.html?page=chara7]official website[/url]]
